artifact: Riplox Desktop 1.6.0 @ 30c2b8c (branch free-features-and-feed) - the change surface since v1.5.0
note: Modelled on the diff, not the whole app: the 1-Sep grid covered the UI. Nazim's complaint is that releases pass their tests and still ship bugs - all three of today's real bugs (channel timeout, https then 360p, slow analyze) passed 1541 unit tests. Those were SITUATIONS, so the factors below are states and conditions, not functions.
note_added_factors: copies and restart came out of the audit. Both earn their place from this release rather than from theory: the drop folder is new shared state that two copies would sweep at once, and a start time is the first thing this app persists that has to survive a restart to mean anything. Two copies fighting over a port has already happened once here.

gates.why: auto-download needs BOTH the per-channel switch and watch_auto in Settings, and an upgraded 1.5.0 file has neither - the app refuses before _auto_download is reached
gates.tested_at: the two-switch guard itself, as its own case

gates.why: convert reads a file already on disk; it has no link at all
gates.tested_at: convert cases, which take a file rather than a link

repros.name: bug-channel-timeout
repros.why: 4-Sep: a channel link never finished reading. analyze() walked the whole channel and paid the politeness pause per page - 86.7s measured, past the 120s timeout on anything larger

repros.name: bug-https-then-360p
repros.why: 4-Sep: best available hit an https error halfway and came back small. A broken connection was in the same list as a refusal, so it spent a client rung, and those rungs only carry small formats

repros.name: bug-slow-single-analyze
repros.why: 4-Sep: one video took 5.3s to read; 2.3s of it was the burst pause on a read a person was waiting for

repros.name: bug-quality-guard-narrow
repros.why: the guard stopped at 360p, so 4K asked and 720p delivered went green and said nothing

repros.name: bug-watch-hours-migration
repros.why: load_settings fills defaults before merging the file, so the old watch_hours key could never be seen missing - a 24-hour choice would have become hourly in silence

repros.name: bug-start-after-race
repros.why: manager.add wakes the workers, so setting start_after afterwards let a 2 a.m. download begin immediately

repros.name: bug-probe-vanish
repros.why: a link the HEAD probe refused fell out of the page's own account of itself - sixty links in, twelve out, no mention of the rest

repros.name: bug-probe-second-door
repros.why: the probe went out through a custom opener, so every test that stubs urlopen was quietly reaching the network

repros.name: bug-unknown-setting-dropped
repros.why: save_settings drops a key that is not in DEFAULT_SETTINGS - a new setting that works for one run and then vanishes

sequences.name: seq-upgrade-then-follow
steps: start with a 1.5.0 settings.json and a 1.5.0 watch.json
load settings - the interval must come from watch_hours, not the default
load the watch list - every item must gain feed/opts/auto/full_checked
check one item - it must not announce the whole back catalogue

sequences.name: seq-drop-twice
steps: write a file of links into the drop folder
sweep - the links are queued and the file becomes .done
sweep again - nothing is queued a second time

sequences.name: seq-convert-onto-itself
steps: take an mp4 already on disk
the original must still be there and the output must be a different file

sequences.name: seq-ladder-blip-then-refusal
steps: a download fails with a network error - the same client is tried again
it fails again with a refusal - now the ladder moves down
the rung that ran must be the second one, not the fourth
